findings.repro: Unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, change into src/claude/skills/review, and execute the command on line 20. It exits 2 with 'ptk_run: no plugin root holds lib/ptk_run.py'.
findings.summary: [P2] Run from the reviewed checkout instead of the skill directory. The documented working directory breaks the relative .claude launcher lookup. With an absolute plugin-root environment variable, the launcher succeeds but --repo defaults to the plugin skill directory, so an external installation reviews the plugin rather than the consumer checkout. The same instructions appear in all five host copies.

overlap_rule: same file and line within 3 of a critic path:line
